column1: 23313§telegraph§ˈtelɪgrɑːf§n. 电报机；电报 v. 打电报，发电报；（无意中）泄露，流露§With development of technology, telegraph as a means of communication has been gradually replaced by mobile phone, Internet and other media means.§随着技术的进步，电报这种交流方式已经逐渐被手机、互联网和其他媒介所取代。
23314§episodic§ˌepɪˈsɒdɪk§adj. 偶然发生的，不定期的；由许多片段组成的，松散的§An episodic format is the writer's favourite, when he tries to relax by writing.§当这个作家想要用写作来放松自己时，他最爱用一种松散的形式来创作。

23315§trespass§ˈtrespəs§vi. 侵犯（某人的财产）；擅闯（某人的领地）；利用（某物）；冒犯，触犯§Farmers have barricaded their fields to stop wild elephants from trespassing on the land in the south of Asia.§在南亚地区，农民在田地里设置障碍物来阻止野象侵犯他们的土地。

23316§millennium§mɪˈleniəm§n. 一千年，千禧年；（未来的）太平盛世§Millennium Bug was really bothering the scientists in 1990s, when the electron technology hadn't been developed as fast as today.§20世纪90年代，电子技术的发展没有现在这样迅速，“千年虫”问题在当时确实困扰着科学家们。

23317§susceptible§səˈseptəbl§adj. 易受影响的，易受伤害的；易受感染的；（人）敏感的，易动感情的；能经受…的，容许…的§A large number of TV advertisement are aimed at susceptible young women who always buy goods they actually don't need.§大量的电视广告瞄准易受影响的年轻女性，她们总是购买一些实际上并不需要的东西。
23318§antiseptic§ˌæntiˈseptɪk§adj. 防腐的，抗菌的 n. 防腐剂，抗菌剂§In old times, the bodies of most of emperors were dealt with antiseptic for lasting for ever.§在古代，为了死后长存，大多数皇帝的遗体都要做防腐处理。
23319§indolent§ˈɪndələnt§adj. 懒惰的，倦怠的；不活跃的，无行动的§Their indolent attitude was the cause of much unnecessary pain and suffering.§他们懒惰的态度是引起很多不必要的痛苦和折磨的原因。
23320§thrifty§ˈθrɪfti§adj. 节俭的，节约的§In ancient time, Chinese people were usually brought up to be thrifty and hard-working.§在古代，中国人在成长过程中常常受到勤俭节约的教育。
23321§nutritious§njuˈtrɪʃəs§adj. 有营养的，营养丰富的§In additional to a nutritious diet, a healthy body also depends on an appropriate exercise.§除了营养的饮食之外，健康的身体还需要适当的运动。
23322§dupe§djuːp§n. 上当者，受骗者 vt. 欺骗，愚弄§Most historians reached the conclusion that the Indian were innocent dupes, blameless in the battle.§许多历史学家都得出这样的结论：印第安人是无辜的受骗者，他们无需担负这场战争的责任。
23323§overfill§ˌəʊvəˈfɪl§v. 装得太多，装到满溢§It's dangerous to overfill liquid storage tanks.§贮罐过量充装液体是危险的。
23324§inviolable§ɪnˈvaɪələbl§adj. 不可侵犯的，不容亵渎的，不容破坏的§What a man has experienced in the privacy must necessarily remain inviolable at any time.§一个人的隐私在任何时候都一定是不可侵犯的。
23325§penalize§ˈpiːnəlaɪz§vt. 惩罚，处罚；判罚；使处于不利地位§It's unfair that the whole medical staff should be penalized just because a nurse made a mistake.§仅仅因为一个护士犯错误，就惩罚所有的医务人员，这是不公平的。

23326§slander§ˈslɑːndə(r)§n. 诋毁，中伤，诽谤（罪） vt. 诋毁，诽谤§Nowadays, it is not rare that stars sue the news agency for their slanders on their good reputation in the entertainment circle.§如今，在娱乐圈，明星指控新闻机构诋毁他们的名誉已屡见不鲜。

23327§restore§rɪˈstɔː(r)§vt. 恢复，使复位；修复，整修，重建；归还，交还§The government has been trying to restore public confidence in its management of the economy since the breakout of economic crisis.§自经济危机爆发以来，该政府就一直试图重建公众对其掌控经济能力的信心。
23328§virtuous§ˈvɜːtʃuəs§adj. 有道德的，品性好的，品德高的；自命清高的；贞洁的§Compared with intelligent people, virtuous and hard-working people will be more welcomed in the office.§与聪明的人相比，品德高尚、刻苦工作的员工在办公室更受欢迎。
23329§superstitious§ˌsuːpəˈstɪʃəs§adj. 迷信的；由迷信引起的；受迷信思想支配的§The majority of people don't believe in the old superstitious saying that the number 13 is unlucky.§大多数人都不相信“数字13不吉利”这一古老的迷信说法。
23330§bead§biːd§n. 珠子；（水、血、汗的）小滴§Don't trifle that string of purple beads which values more than five million dollars.§别小瞧了那串紫色的珠子，它价值高达500多万美元。
23331§malt§mɔːlt§n. 麦芽；麦芽酒 v. 把…制成麦芽；（谷物）变成麦芽§A bottle of 15-year-old malt whisky is taken out by the hostess to entertain her guests.§女主人拿出一瓶15年陈酿的麦芽威士忌招待客人。
23332§augment§ɔːgˈment§vt. 增加；提高；扩大§Cities today are competing for the best talent that can augment the productivity of their economy.§今天的各个城市正在争夺可以提高经济生产率的最优秀人才。

23333§agile§ˈædʒaɪl§adj. 敏捷的，灵活的，机敏的§On the contrary to traditional idea, many interviewers prefer candidates with agile mind to those with high marks at universities.§与传统观点相反，许多面试官更喜欢思维敏捷的求职者，而不是那些在大学取得高分的人。
23334§tribal§ˈtraɪbl§adj. 部落的，部族的§At the first sight of tribal arts and dress on the island, tourists will certainly be attracted.§当游客第一眼看到岛上的部落艺术和服饰时，就一定会被其吸引。

23335§precede§prɪˈsiːd§v. 领先，先于§If people were to precede the comprehensive notion of environmental protection, species would not face the situation of becoming extinct any more.§如果人类早些对环境保护有一个全面的概念，就不会有更多物种面临灭绝的危险了。
23336§alleviate§əˈliːvieɪt§vt. 减轻，缓解，缓和§An injection did little to alleviate Jane's pain after operation.§注射药物并没有缓解简手术后的疼痛。

23337§antibiotic§ˌæntibaɪˈɒtɪk§n. 抗生素；抗菌素 adj. 抗菌的；抗生素的§Although antibiotic can be used against infection, doctors won't persuade their patients to take it for a long time.§虽然抗菌素可以用来防止感染，但医生并不建议病人长期服用。
23338§overexploit§ˌəʊvərɪksˈplɔɪt§vt. 过度开采§Many valuable natural resources, like coal and oil, are in the verge of exhaustion because people are overexploiting them.§由于人们过度开采，像煤和石油之类宝贵的自然资源正濒临枯竭。
23339§grill§grɪl§vt. 烧烤；拷问，盘问 n. 烤架§Our leader grilled us about why we were absent from evening party after meeting.§我们领导盘问我们为什么缺席会议之后的晚会。
23340§inculcate§ˈɪnkʌlkeɪt§vt. 谆谆教诲，反复灌输§Chinese parents try to inculcate a sense of social responsibility in their children when they are still young.§中国的父母在孩子很小的时候就试图向他们灌输一种社会责任感。
23341§brutal§ˈbruːtl§adj. 野兽般的，残忍的；无情的，冷酷的§It was not the first time to report the brutal treatment towards prisoners by the troops.§这已经不是第一次报道军队虐待战俘的情况了。
23342§avenge§əˈvendʒ§vt. 报仇，复仇§Study shows that some people are likely to avenge society once they are treated unequally.§研究发现，一些人一旦受到不公平的待遇，就很可能报复社会。
23343§invasive§ɪnˈveɪsɪv§adj. 侵略的，入侵的；（疾病等）侵袭的，扩散的；切入的，开刀的§§

23344§upgrade§ˌʌpˈɡreɪd§vt. 使（机器等）升级，提高，改进；提拔，提升；改善[ˈʌpɡreɪd] n. 向上的斜坡；增加，改善§With the increase in terrorism attacks, more and more international airports plan to upgrade the safety check systems.§随着恐怖主义袭击的增加，越来越多的国际机场计划升级安检系统。

23345§commute§kəˈmjuːt§v. （乘公共汽车等）上下班往返，经常往返；交换，抵偿；减刑 n.§Eventually, it is predicted that many people may be able to work at home instead of commuting at office in the future.§据预测，在未来许多人最终可以在家办公，而不用乘公交往返上下班。

23346§legislative§ˈledʒɪslətɪv§adj. 立法的，有立法权的；根据法规执行的；立法机关的 n. 立法机关§The United Nations has taken new legislative measures to stem the flow of weapons into the developing countries.§联合国已采取新的法律措施来阻止武器流入发展中国家。

23347§differentiate§ˌdɪfəˈrenʃieɪt§v. 区分，区别；差别对待，区别对待§The main aim of the management course is to teach us how to differentiate primary work from secondary work in the office.§该管理课程的主要目的是教我们如何区分首要工作和次要工作。
23348§sentient§ˈsentiənt§adj. 有感觉能力的，有知觉力的；知悉的§Because animals are living and sentient beings, they deserve special protection and respect.§动物是活生生、有知觉的生物，它们应该受到特殊的保护和尊重。
23349§pour§pɔː(r)§v. 灌，倒；倾泻，涌流；喷发；不断涌向（或涌现）§Old customers pour out of the shopping centres cheering wildly at the weekends.§周末，老顾客欢欣雀跃地从购物中心蜂拥而出。
23350§hook§hʊk§n. 钩，吊钩，钩状物 v. （使）钩住，挂住；钓（鱼）§Paul hooked his tractor to the car and pulled it to safety.§保罗把他的拖拉机挂在那辆小汽车上，然后把它拖到安全的地方。
23351§tighten§ˈtaɪtn§v. （使）变紧；使更加严格，加强§During that special period, everyone must tighten their belt as a result of national income and foreign trade stagnation.§在那段特殊时期，由于国内收益和国外贸易的停滞，每个人都要勒紧腰带过日子。

23352§humane§hjuːˈmeɪn§adj. 善良的，人道的，仁慈的，慈悲的；（指学科）促进文明或教化的，人文的§A series of campaign for the humane treatment of wildlife has been launched throughout the world in recent years.§近年来，全世界发起了一连串的宣传善待野生生物的活动。

23353§infiltrate§ˈɪnfɪltreɪt§v. （使）悄悄进入，潜入；渗入，渗透§Many companies want their new employees to quickly adapt themselves to working environment and infiltrate corporate culture.§许多公司希望新员工很快适应工作环境并融入企业文化。者）
23354§violate§ˈvaɪəleɪt§vt. 违反，违犯，违背；亵渎；侵犯，干扰§The legislative should take measures to prevent the mass media from violating the public's privacy.§立法机构应该采取措施制止大众媒体侵犯人们的隐私。

23355§glacier§ˈɡlæsiə(r)§n. 冰川，冰河§Glacier Bay, located in southeast Alaska, United States, is a narrow inlet of the Pacific Ocean which runs from northwest to southeast for about 105 kilometers.§冰川湾，位于美国阿拉斯加东南部，是太平洋的一个狭窄入海口，它自西北流向东南，全长约105公里。
23356§hereditary§həˈredɪtri§adj. （尤指疾病）遗传的，遗传性的；可继承的，世袭的§Albinism is a hereditary disease, which can be visual when the recessive gene does work.§白化病是一种遗传性疾病，当隐性基因表现出来时就会发病，显示症状。
23357§insidious§ɪnˈsɪdiəs§adj. 潜伏的，隐伏的§Hypertension is usually an insidious disease which has few symptoms in the early stage.§高血压通常是一种潜伏性疾病，早期几乎没有症状。

23358§discharge§ˈdɪstʃɑːdʒ§n. 排出（物）；获准离开，免职；履行，执行；（债务的）清偿[dɪsˈtʃɑːdʒ] v. 解雇；释放；排出，放出；放（电）；完成，履行§Thousands of marine organisms were murdered as a result of a discharge of toxic wastes from a nearby chemical factory.§附近一个化工厂排出的有毒废料造成数以千计海洋生物的死亡。

23359§refrain§rɪˈfreɪn§v. 抑制，克制 n. （诗歌的）叠句；（歌曲的）副歌；经常重复的评价§The survey finds that the majority of people can refrain from smoking in public places such as theater and museum.§调查发现，在剧院和博物馆这类公共场所大多数人能够克制住不抽烟。
23360§supportive§səˈpɔːtɪv§adj. 支持的，支援的；赞助的；鼓励的；同情的§Children can often do better at school for they have supportive parents.§有父母的支持，孩子们在学校常常会表现得更好。

23361§accustom§əˈkʌstəm§vt. 使习惯于§If you go abroad for further study, it will take a period of time for you to accustom yourself to the new environment, the new culture and all the new rules and regulations.§如果你出国留学，那么你需要花上一些时间让自己习惯新的环境、新的文化和所有新的规则与制度。
23362§inalienable§ɪnˈeɪliənəbl§adj. 不可剥夺的，不可分割的§From my point of view, childbirth is the inalienable right of female employees who work in private companies.§在我看来，生孩子是在私企工作的女性员工不可剥夺的权利。
23363§savour§ˈseɪvə(r)§vt. 品尝，品味；欣赏；体会，体味 n. 味道，风味；情趣，吸引力§Every day, people should afford a short moment to savour the gain and loss of the whole day before going to bed.§每天，人们都应该在睡觉前抽出片刻来品味一天的得与失。
23364§pump§pʌmp§v. 用泵抽（水）；涌出，奔流 n. 泵，抽水机§The villagers were tired of getting water from several miles away, so they invented an machine for pumping groundwater.§村民们厌倦了到几英里之外的地方打水，于是他们发明了一种可以抽地下水的机器。
23365§astronomy§əˈstrɒnəmi§n. 天文学§Astronomy is an extensive science, which can connect with physics, optics and astrology.§天文学是一门涉及广泛的科学，可以与物理学、光学和占星学相关联。
23366§hazardous§ˈhæzədəs§adj. 危险的，冒险的；有害的§The acid rain in big cities can be hazardous to the environment where people live and their health.§大城市中的酸雨会危害人们生活的环境以及他们的健康。
23367§segregate§ˈsegrɪgeɪt§vt. 隔离，使分开§It is necessary to segregate two groups of fans in the stadium, in case of unnecessary fight after the game.§为了避免赛后不必要的争斗，将体育场的两部分球迷隔开是非常必要的。
23368§tillable§ˈtɪləbl§adj. 适宜耕种的，可耕种的§Scientists have found that tillable lands have declined sharply in recent years due to global warming.§科学家发现，近年来由于全球变暖，可耕种土地骤减。
23369§overgraze§ˌəʊvəˈɡreɪz§v. 过度放牧§Once the grass land is overgrazed, the vegetation will be damaged and the ground will become liable to erosion.§一旦草地遭到过度放牧，就会导致植被受损，土壤易于流失。
23370§embody§ɪmˈbɒdi§vt. （作品等）表达，体现；具体表现，使具体化；包括，包含§As a rule, if you want to write a good essay, you'd better list some relevant examples embodying the gist.§通常，如果你想写出好文章，你最好列举一些体现文章主旨的相关例子。
23371§reciprocate§rɪˈsɪprəkeɪt§v. 回报，回应；报答§Generally speaking, people will reciprocate the kindness that have been shown to them before.§一般而言，人们会回报之前受到的恩惠。
23372§moribund§ˈmɒrɪbʌnd§adj. 垂死的，即将灭亡的；即将结束的§There is a big problem for that country at present that how the economy can be revived from its present moribund state.§该国眼下的一个大难题是经济如何从濒临崩溃的状态中走向复苏。

23373§isolated§ˈaɪsəleɪtɪd§adj. 隔离的，分离的；与世隔绝的，偏僻的；孤立的，孤独的；个别的§Old people could easily become a socially isolated group, so they should keep moving and maintain interaction with the outside world.§老年人很容易变成与社会脱节的一个群体，所以他们应该不断前进并保持与外界的互动。
23374§modish§ˈməʊdɪʃ§adj. 流行的，时髦的§Nowadays, there is an interesting phenomenon that some bygone fashions, such as mini-skirt, become modish again.§如今，一个有趣的现象是一些过去的时尚再度流行开来，如迷你裙。
23375§maltreat§ˌmælˈtriːt§vt. 虐待§It is necessary for the government to make relevant laws to punish people who maltreat domestic animals.§政府有必要制定相关法律来惩罚虐待家养动物的人。
23376§disobey§ˌdɪsəˈbeɪ§v. 不服从，违抗§To question or disobey the law is tantamount to destroying the authority of the law.§质疑或违抗法律，等同于摧毁法律的权威。
23377§versatile§ˈvɜːsətaɪl§adj. 多才多艺的，多面手的；多用途的，通用的§Because honey is versatile and not expensive, it is widely used in every aspect of our daily life.§蜂蜜具有多种功能且价格不贵，因此被广泛应用于日常生活的各个方面。
23378§grudge§grʌdʒ§n. 不满，积怨，怀恨 v. 勉强做；不情愿地给，吝惜§Owing a grudge against somebody or something consumes one's energies and finally accomplishes nothing at all.§对某个人或某件事记仇会耗费一个人的精力，到最后一无所获。
23379§pretentious§prɪˈtenʃəs§adj. 自命不凡的，自负的；炫耀的；做作的§The writer took a book review in pretentious language to express his biased criticism.§该作者写了一篇书评，言语间满是自负，表达了相当偏执的评论意见。

23380§enlist§ɪnˈlɪst§v. 征募；从军，参军；谋取（帮助、支持等）§At present, tens of thousands of volunteers are being enlisted all over the country to serve the approaching Winter Olympics.§目前，正在全国范围内招募成千上万的志愿者，为即将到来的冬奥会服务。
23381§curb§kɜːb§vt. 控制，抑制，约束 n. 路缘，（街道的）镶边石；马勒；起限制作用的事物§The effective measure to curb the spread of the virus is keeping the computer off.§控制病毒传播最有效的方法就是不开电脑。

23382§elaboration§ɪˌlæbəˈreɪʃn§n. 精心之作；详尽阐述§After the homework has been discussed, the teacher explains the topic of the lesson, slowly and with a lot of repetition and elaboration.§讨论完作业之后，教师会缓慢地、反复精细地讲解这节课的主题。

23383§snobbish§ˈsnɒbɪʃ§adj. 势利的，谄上欺下的；自命不凡的§In current society, some people are very snobbish, who'd like to make friends only with people of wealth and of high social status.§在当今社会，有些人非常势利，他们只愿意与有钱和社会地位高的人交朋友。
23384§magnet§ˈmægnət§n. 磁铁，磁石；磁体；有吸引力的人或物§Paris has always played a role of a magnet to attract people to seek romance and true love.§巴黎一直扮演着一个磁铁一样的角色，不断吸引着想要寻找浪漫和真爱的人们。
23385§prevalence§ˈprevələns§n. 普及，流行，盛行§The illness on neck, which used to bother the elderly, is of prevalence among young office workers nowadays.§过去常常烦扰老年人的颈椎病现在盛行于年轻的上班族之中。
23386§bleak§bliːk§adj. 寒冷的，阴沉的；阴郁的，暗淡的；没有希望的；荒凉的§The future looks bleak for the fishing industry.§渔业前景暗淡。
23387§ecliptic§ɪˈklɪptɪk§n. 【天】黄道 adj. 黄道的；日（或月）食的§There is an angle between the ecliptic plane and the equatorial plane which is called the obliquity of the ecliptic.§黄道面与赤道面之间有一个夹角被称为黄赤交角。
